summary: People search stayed on "Searching…" for good when the text changed without the search changing: a space typed after the name (a phone's keyboard adds one with every word it completes), or typing on and back within the debounce. The debounce marked a search as in flight but sent nothing, since the trimmed query was the one already searched, so nothing ever answered it. Fixed in useDebouncedSearchQuery: only a search that goes out is awaited.
